title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
This cumulative Korean edition contains complete EGA 0_I, EGA I, EGA II, and EGA III-1. EGA III-1 comprises the continuation of Chapter 0 (sections 8–13), Chapter III sections 1–5, and its bibliography and original contents through the end of the admitted corrected-current French source. Later parts of EGA III and later EGA volumes are not included; this version makes no claim that the wider EGA corpus is complete.

The human-readable preview is 00_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE_READER.pdf, uploaded first. It is a 602-page A4 PDF of 3,311,979 bytes with SHA-256 942945B123903A34F1295399BAD282658916D52174AA3616B6380A60E571FC59. It preserves 581 historical source-page markers while adding Korean edition front matter, linked contents, internal navigation, embedded Korean and mathematical fonts, and searchable Unicode text.

The second file, 01_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE.tex, is a directly downloadable, fully assembled cumulative LaTeX source of 2,416,890 bytes with SHA-256 2B9479D8124576B45CAEFC43D8E8A90567F99DAFD8494B357471AF350ED6655E. It contains the complete released text rather than a thin master that depends on unpublished inputs. The third file is a deterministic ZIP of the original modular source tree, all 21 ordered inputs, the cumulative driver, coverage manifest, portable mutex-aware build script, build instructions, citation metadata, and rights notice.

The bounded evidence archive contains the source-admission and structural receipts, the sole whole-volume content-check receipt and its finite finding disposition, the converged-build receipt, the single aggregate 602-page PDF validation receipt, machine-readable choice ledgers, five contact sheets covering every page, the boundary/finding sheet, and the full-resolution rendered page used to resolve the only extraction flag. It excludes the transient 602-page full-resolution render set.

The reader was produced in one machine-wide-mutex-serialized four-pass XeLaTeX convergence build; passes three and four are byte-identical. Exactly one aggregate output validation followed: one extraction, one full render of all 602 pages, one geometry and ink-safety scan, and one visual-inspection cycle. There were no per-section or small-unit QA loops and no repeated whole-reader QA loop. All 44 fonts are embedded, all 5,035 internal links resolve, required DOI and repository links are live in the PDF, and no replacement characters, edge collisions, black pages, clipping, or broken diagrams were found.

Three literal question-mark pairs in plain-text extraction were confined to the arrow glyphs of one Xy-pic diagram on physical page 192. The already generated full-resolution render shows the intended arrows correctly; the finding is a ToUnicode limitation of an inherited diagram font, not missing visible content. Editable TeX and rendered formulae and diagrams remain authoritative where legacy mathematics-font extraction is lossy.

The stable Korean EGA concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21921513; this exact version is 10.5281/zenodo.22864049. The public source, issue history, and releases are maintained at github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. This is the existing Korean EGA lineage, not a competing record and not a merger with FGA, SGA, Chinese, or Japanese editions.

Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné are the historical creators of the mathematical work. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor.
